notes: Revenue mix and risk profile partly rely on general knowledge of lease-to-own accounting.

sub_sector.value: lease-to-own consumer financing; buy now pay later; payroll-deduction purchase programs

financial_business_type.detail: Fintech holding: lease-to-own, BNPL, cash-advance app and employee purchase programs for consumers.

revenue_driver.detail: Lease revenues and fees from consumer leases and BNPL, plus retailer-paid fees; lease-to-own is largest.

customer_type.detail: Consumers of all financial backgrounds, plus retailers and employers offering purchase programs to employees.

balance_sheet_dependence.detail: Owns leased merchandise and carries consumer credit and payment risk on lease and BNPL receivables.
